name: Abracadabra ZeroXStargateLPSwapper public swap with caller-supplied 0x calldata
summary: Abracadabra's ZeroXStargateLPSwapper.swap() had no caller check, forwarded caller-supplied calldata to the 0x exchange proxy and deposited its whole MIM balance to a caller-chosen recipient, so the attacker converted the 17,973 USDT left in the swapper by an earlier liquidation into MIM for itself, 147 days after deployment.
